items.title: Meta’s Q3 revenue rose 26% year over year to $64.60 billion, beating expectations of $63.37 billion by roughly 1.9%.
items.quickTake: Investor focus remains on whether revenue growth can offset heavy AI spending and legal costs. The report also cited a $25 billion New Mexico penalty; Reality Labs’ quarterly results were still pending.

attachedThreads.title: Meta reached $777.89 on September 24, its highest level in nearly a year, following renewed optimism after the Meta Connect conference.
attachedThreads.quickTake: The main risks are enormous AI capital expenditures, projected negative free cash flow through 2028 and a possible false breakout; falling below $737 could weaken momentum, with support around $691, $658 and $626.
